name: Zhiqing
source:
A college student majoring in computer science, she has excellent grades and a solid grasp of the subject matter, and can even complete some small games on her own. Her current goal is to join the internet company where Yumo works after graduation, which should be a safe bet given her current level.
She is also far superior to her peers in cooking, but surprisingly not good at other household chores.

[Translated from [url=https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/3852]CnGal[/url]]
